## Comparison to LLM arms on the SAME F-S 40 held-out set

*LLM arm F1s taken from `llm_arms_vs_fs_gold_fs_test_{base,tuned_v3}.csv` (scored via `score_llm_arms_vs_fs_gold.py --held-out-only`). These arms are scored against F-S native clinician-adjudicated gold on a smaller field set (7 fields — see docs/FONFERKO_GOLD_SCOPE.md). Arm B1' is scored against derived v0.2.1 silver on 13 populated fields. **Direct F1 comparison is directional only** — the two scoring conventions differ.*

| Arm | Notes | Mean F1 (per-field) |
|---|---|---:|
| M0 base    | Med42 zero-shot                     | 0.014 |
| M1 base    | + few-shot                          | 0.037 |
| M2 base    | + schema injection                  | 0.000 |
| M0 tuned_v3| Med42 + LoRA (synth+fs80 tune)      | 0.055 |
| M1 tuned_v3| tuned + few-shot                    | 0.040 |
| M2 tuned_v3| tuned + schema inj                  | 0.000 |
| **B1' MedCAT+Rules** | this work           | **0.482** (macro) / **0.563** (micro) |

**Positioning:** MedCAT+Rules leads the F-S 40 held-out on scalar clinical fields where the LLM arms score near-zero F1 (epilepsy_type, predominant_seizure_type, age_at_onset). LLM arms are competitive only on current_asms multiset extraction. B1' is currently the highest-scoring arm on this held-out set among all evaluated methods, but sits BELOW the pre-UMLS floor target of 0.68.
